title: Problem
问题
html: DataSciBench asks how to evaluate LLM agents on realistic data-science tasks where ground truth and metrics are not always simple or single-task. The primary source is the arXiv paper submitted on 19 February 2025, with official code/data links to the THUDM GitHub repository and Hugging Face dataset. It is in scope as a benchmark and executable metric surface for data-science agents. It is not only a table QA set or a Kaggle-style leaderboard clone. A task contains a natural data-science prompt, task type, data files or context, generated code/output, ground truth, metric function, and programmatic scoring rule. The atlas value is its explicit Task-Function-Code feedback contract.

DataSciBench 研究如何评测 LLM agent 的真实数据科学能力，尤其是 ground truth 和 metric 不总是简单可得、任务也不只是单一类型的情况。主要来源是 2025 年 2 月 19 日提交的 arXiv 论文，以及官方 THUDM GitHub 和 Hugging Face 数据链接。它属于 benchmark / executable metric surface，因为评分围绕数据科学任务、代码执行和指标函数；它不是普通表格问答集，也不是简单复刻 Kaggle 榜单。一个任务包含自然数据科学 prompt、任务类型、数据文件或上下文、生成代码/输出、GT、metric function 和程序化评分规则。对 atlas 的价值是明确的 Task-Function-Code 反馈契约。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is a data-science agent benchmark that combines curated natural prompts, semi-automated ground-truth generation, metric validation, and a Task-Function-Code framework for evaluating executed code outcomes. The core mechanism is to use predefined task types and aggregate functions, then apply LLM self-consistency plus human verification to produce or validate ground truth. The data object is a data-science task with executable metric logic, not just a final text answer. The feedback contract is programmatic: code outputs are assessed by defined metrics and rules. Closest comparisons are single-task data benchmarks and straightforward metric datasets. Direction label: executable data-science evaluation surface.

核心贡献是一套数据科学 agent benchmark，把自然且有挑战的 prompts、半自动 GT 生成、metric 验证和 Task-Function-Code 框架结合起来，用于评估代码执行结果。核心机制是先定义任务类型和聚合函数，再用 LLM self-consistency 加人工验证来产生或验证 GT。数据对象是带可执行 metric 逻辑的数据科学任务，不只是最终文本答案。反馈契约是程序化的：代码输出由精确定义的指标和规则评估。最近对比对象是单任务数据 benchmark 和指标简单的数据集。方向标签是可执行数据科学评测面。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Inputs: collected natural data-science prompts, datasets or task context, predefined task types, and aggregate functions or metrics.
  2. Ground-truth pipeline: generate candidate GT with LLM-based self-consistency, then validate it with human verification.
  3. TFC evaluation: map each task to a function and code-based metric rule, execute or inspect the model-produced outcome, and score it by the defined rule.
  4. Outputs: model code/output, execution outcome, metric value, pass/fail or task score, and benchmark-level aggregates.
  5. Feedback contract: the TFC metric and programmatic rule determine acceptance; human verification is used for GT/metric validation, not as an opaque preference judge for every output.
  6. Reproducibility notes: pin dataset revision, execution environment, package versions, random seeds, metric code, answer parser, prompt/scaffold, timeout, and any human-verification protocol.

1. 输入：收集到的自然数据科学 prompts、数据集或任务上下文、预定义任务类型，以及聚合函数或指标。
  2. GT 流程：用 LLM self-consistency 生成候选 GT，再通过人工验证确认。
  3. TFC 评测：把每个任务映射到 function 和基于代码的 metric rule，执行或检查模型产物，并按定义规则计分。
  4. 输出：模型代码/结果、执行结果、metric value、pass/fail 或任务分，以及 benchmark 聚合指标。
  5. 反馈契约：TFC metric 与程序化规则决定是否接受；人工验证用于 GT/metric 校验，不是对每个模型输出的黑箱偏好 judge。
  6. 复现边界：需固定数据集版本、执行环境、依赖包版本、随机种子、metric code、答案解析器、prompt/scaffold、timeout 和人工验证协议。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The arXiv abstract reports experiments on 6 API-based models, 8 open-source general models, and 9 open-source code-generation models. It reports that API-based models outperform open-source models on all metrics, and that Deepseek-Coder-33B-Instruct is the best open-source model among those evaluated. The decisive instance-level evidence is the Task-Function-Code score: an executed outcome is checked by a metric and programmatic rule tied to the task. The evidence boundary is that scores depend on execution environment, metric implementation, GT validation, prompt/scaffold, and dataset revision. Aggregate model ordering should not be reused without the official metric code and release version.

arXiv 摘要报告实验覆盖 6 个 API 模型、8 个开源通用模型和 9 个开源代码生成模型。作者报告 API 模型在所有指标上优于开源模型，且 Deepseek-Coder-33B-Instruct 是所评测开源模型中表现最好的。逐实例决定性证据是 Task-Function-Code 分数：执行结果由与任务绑定的 metric 和程序化规则检查。证据边界是：分数受执行环境、metric 实现、GT 验证、prompt/scaffold 和数据集版本影响。复用模型排序前必须固定官方 metric code 和 release 版本。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The prior baseline is a benchmark with a single task type, easy ground truth, and direct metrics. DataSciBench changes the construction process by handling uncertain GT and task-specific metrics through semi-automated generation plus human verification. It also changes scoring by representing evaluation as Task-Function-Code rather than one global answer comparison. The direction signal is useful for agent evaluation because many data-science tasks need code execution, aggregate metrics, and validated GT. The quality signal is the explicit metric-validation pipeline. What is not new: code execution, aggregate metrics, and human verification are existing components. Reuse requires checking dataset license, data provenance, metric correctness, GT ambiguity, package drift, and whether tasks have leaked into training data.

已有基线通常只有单一任务类型、容易获得的 GT 和直接指标。DataSciBench 改变的是构造流程：用半自动生成加人工验证处理不确定 GT 和任务特定 metric。它还把评分表示成 Task-Function-Code，而不是一个全局答案比较函数。方向信号是：许多数据科学 agent 任务需要代码执行、聚合指标和经过验证的 GT。质量信号是显式 metric-validation pipeline。并不新的部分是代码执行、聚合指标和人工验证这些组件。复用前要检查数据集 license、数据来源、metric 正确性、GT 歧义、依赖包漂移和任务是否进入训练数据。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Correctness is only as strong as the validated GT and metric implementation. A model may solve a data-science task in a semantically valid way that fails if the expected output format, aggregation rule, or tolerance is too narrow. Human verification improves GT quality but introduces protocol and annotator-decision boundaries that must be documented. Execution scores can drift with library versions, randomness, hardware, and timeout policy. Public release creates contamination risk. The benchmark should not be treated as a training reward source unless metric code, data rights, and unsafe code-execution controls are separately audited.

正确性只与已验证 GT 和 metric 实现一样可靠。模型可能用语义有效的数据科学方法完成任务，但因输出格式、聚合规则或容差太窄而失败。人工验证能提升 GT 质量，但也引入协议和标注决策边界，必须记录。执行分数会随库版本、随机性、硬件和 timeout 策略漂移。公开发布带来污染风险。除非单独审计 metric code、数据权利和不安全代码执行控制，否则不应直接把该 benchmark 当训练奖励来源。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use DataSciBench as a schema for data-science agent evaluation where each task carries its own function and metric. Preserve prompt, data files, task type, GT provenance, metric function, metric validation notes, model code, execution logs, package versions, random seed, timeout/error state, and score. For atlas work, it helps design benchmark records that distinguish generated code, executed result, metric output, and verified GT. It is also a useful audit checklist for whether a data-science benchmark has only easy answer keys or a real executable feedback contract.

DataSciBench 可作为数据科学 agent 评测 schema：每个任务都带自己的 function 和 metric。复用时应保留 prompt、数据文件、任务类型、GT provenance、metric function、metric 验证说明、模型代码、执行日志、依赖包版本、随机种子、timeout/error 状态和分数。对 atlas 来说，它能帮助设计区分生成代码、执行结果、metric 输出和已验证 GT 的 benchmark 记录。它也适合作为审计清单：一个数据科学 benchmark 只是有简单答案键，还是有真实可执行反馈契约。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the TFC framework before comparing model rankings. The benchmark's distinctive claim is not only that it has data-science prompts, but that GT and metrics are validated for tasks where simple answer keys are insufficient. Keep GT generation, metric validation, code execution, and final aggregate model scores separate. A leaderboard row without execution environment and metric revision is not reproducible evidence.
比较模型排名前，应先读 TFC 框架。它的关键 claim 不只是“有数据科学 prompts”，而是在简单答案键不足的任务上验证 GT 和 metric。GT 生成、metric 验证、代码执行和最终模型聚合分数要分开。没有执行环境和 metric 版本的榜单行，不能当作可复现证据。
